shared_elements: low-relief carving on a stone surface
incised linear ornament on the body/field
justification: Both show low-relief, schematic anthropomorphic imagery and include a round disc element, but that is about as generic as shared content gets. A is a single monumental figure carved in the round with ornament (bands, discs, a pendant-like ring) laid over its own body and head, while B is a flat rectangular panel bearing a multi-figure narrative scene with figures facing one another, an enclosure/canopy structure and small subsidiary figures below — different compositional schemes entirely.
